ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 5080 SOLID OC

The ZOTAC GAMING GeFroce RTX™ 5080 SOLID OC is a no-frills, all-action package to sate your need for performance and speed. Featuring NVIDIA‘s cutting-edge Blackwell architecture and features like DLSS4 and flagship-level cooling solution, the SOLID OC is built tough and hard-hitting for gaming and beyond.

Feature Highlights: - Powered by the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and DLSS 4 - Strong Performance - IceStorm 3.0 Advanced Cooling - Larger Vapor Chamber - BladeLink Fans - Reinforced Metal Mid-Frame - FREEZE Fan Stop, Active Fan Control, Dual BIOS - SPECTRA 2.0 RGB Lighting - SPECTRA LINK Lighting Sync port - Metal die-cast Backplate - Bundled with GPU Support Bracket - 12V-2x6 Safety Light - All-new FireStorm Utility (DOWNLOAD)
